About Gram (formerly Toncoin)

Gram is the native coin of The Open Network (TON), a blockchain closely integrated with Telegram. It was called Toncoin (TON) until a June 2026 community vote renamed it Gram; balances and addresses did not change.

Where this GRAM price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (TON-USD), Binance (GRAM/USDT) and Kraken (TON/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 2.84B GRAM (supply last updated October 30, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.

Gram (formerly Toncoin) previously traded under the ticker TON; old TON links on this site redirect here.
